# GLRA Realty

> GLRA Realty is a licensed real estate brokerage in Makati City, Philippines, founded in 2018 and led by licensed real estate broker Catherine SB Sampayo (Kate Sampayo). It lists condos, houses, lots and commercial property for sale and for lease across Metro Manila and Luzon, and its sister office, GLRA Land Title Documentation and Allied Services (Lucena City), handles title transfer, estate settlement and other land title work.

Office: 17th Floor, 252 Sen. Gil J. Puyat Avenue, Makati City, Metro Manila. By appointment, Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM. Phone +63 917 177 4572, email glrarealty@gmail.com.

## Listings
- [All properties for sale and lease](https://glrarealty.com/properties.html): every listing on one map, each checked by a licensed broker before it goes live

## Services
- [Title transfer and estate settlement](https://glrarealty.com/titling.html): transfer of title, estate settlement for heirs, lost titles, correction of entry, due diligence
- [List your property](https://glrarealty.com/list-property.html): for owners who want to sell or lease
- [Free valuation](https://glrarealty.com/valuation.html)
